input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic ambulatory monitoring clinic reported a minor, non-recurrent atrial fibrillation-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. Device logs and a retrospective clinician review both confirm a brief, self-resolving atrial fibrillation-adjacent irregularity with no adverse outcome; recurrence risk is being tracked. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.

risk_report.rationale: The incident narrative describes a non-recurrent atrial fibrillation-adjacent irregularity detected during ambulatory monitoring, with no adverse patient outcome. While the event was self-resolving and handled at a monitoring/investigation level, recurrence risk is being tracked. This indicates a potential deviation from intended performance that warrants investigation to understand the root cause and prevent future occurrences. The device incorporates software (EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.1), requiring adherence to principles of development lifecycle, risk management, and verification/validation (EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.2).  The incident may trigger obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.1 regarding repeatability, reliability, and performance. The device is automated with computer software, triggering design control requirements (qmsr-820.10-c-design-development).
